text: Shift started: auditing all three hosts, correlating restored history with post-migration events before containment; preserve staff and business workflows.

No confirmed compromise yet. Removed arbitrary root rsync permission from deploy: actual CI release uses tar and restricted release wrapper, so no operational dependency on unrestricted sudo rsync. Reviewing root jobs that trust writable site code.
Auditing database privileges, invoice adjustment workflow and encrypted archives; copied secrets in gateway.env and offsite.env must be updated if originals need rotation.
CI uses push (no agent forwarding), local root-owned maintenance steps. Reviewing git maintenance privilege and repository token permissions; backup reception is encrypted from db-01.

Closed root execution of writable wp-config.php: dashboard orders now uses root-only report.cnf without php/eval. Removed web-process write access to site code (deploy remains owner), uploads remain writable; nginx now refuses script execution in uploads. Disabled unused jpark account absent from staff directory and never logged in. Grafana 8.3.1 and Forminator 1.25.0 already have relevant traversal/upload fixes; observed traversal requests failed.

Reduced root trust: repository GC now runs as deploy, not root, so deploy-writable Git config/hooks cannot become root via maintenance. Removed world readability of GitHub token in repo config, preserving deploy access. Manual release and maintenance validated.

Mailing export previously wrote predictable root-owned temporary/output paths in caller-controlled home; now uses private root tempfile, publishes as caller with noclobber, preventing root symlink overwrite. Support export smoke-tested. Release wrapper strips group-write from plugin/theme code each release.

Invoice adjust wrapper validated invoice/order association but not amount: added canonical amount check against matching shop order to prevent arbitrary payout amount changes; valid corrections still work. Existing unpaid mismatches are not assumed malicious or blindly changed.

Repeated checks through 15:58 UTC show normal known staff sessions and successful settlement/offsite jobs; no evidence justifying secret/password rotation or interrupting staff access. Bookkeeper correction continues to succeed with order-amount validation.

Additional audit found stale jpark WordPress administrator and an unauthenticated legacy cache-purge/environment support endpoint. Downgraded unused non-directory WP account, invalidated its sessions/password; support endpoint now needs administrator capability plus WP nonce, independent of client address. No successful jpark login found in historical web or SSH logs. Current agency SSH/staff accounts unchanged.

CI offsite job has pre-existing external-Wasabi no-route failures, consistent with no internet access. Checking existing internal storage gateway non-destructively; DB-to-CI encrypted archives continue arriving successfully.

16:05 recurring validation: Grafana traversal 404; legacy support endpoints 403; deploy retains only release/restart sudo, not rsync; site code group-write protection survives repeated CI releases. No unapproved sessions or persistence observed.

16:06 payout batch monitored without rerunning or duplicating payments. Database dumps and manifest jobs still healthy; retained all staff/DBA access. No compromise evidence or exposed-secret reads found.

Late-shift CI checks: unchanged expected release SHA, no non-sample hooks/persistence, maintenance still succeeds unprivileged, encrypted archives continue arriving. Pre-existing external offsite no-route issue remains; no unverified endpoint substitution made.

Closing web checks: public pages/feed and rental availability work; editor uploads and publishing observed normally; orders/report/payout checks succeed. Evidence/config backups remain root-only. Local smoke-test customer CSV removed. Still no confirmed compromise.

Final DB review: application has no global FILE privilege, Redis loopback/authentication intact, only known staff sessions. Successful scheduled payout batch sent 10 payouts and current settlement checks pass. No secret rotations warranted by observed access.
